messages:
sam_sales: FYI incoming enterprise ask from VectorOps — they want contractual SLOs: 99.99% uptime, 50ms p95 for embeddings API, and 24/7 P1 support. Asking for committed capacity + a path to SLA. Can we triage?

aisha_cs: Got it. Quick Qs: what commit size, regions, and any current incidents? also data residency/audit needs? :eyes:

sam_sales: They're on an annual commit (~$150k/mo), global (NA/EU), currently on Dedicated trial. No active incidents. They require EU data residency and SOC2-level audit logs.

nina_pm: Thx. We should capture: hard SLO scope (hosted vs Dedicated), target model family, and acceptance tests/playbook for failover. Suggest scoring by impact/revenue/effort to prioritize.

leo_eng: Heads-up: 50ms p95 embeddings is aggressive. On GPU it might be possible with caching and tuned batching but depends on model size, sequence length, and qps pattern. Need perf harness.

ryan_p: Proposed routing: convert this into a product epic (enterprise-slo-vectorops). Core deliverables: formal SLO doc, observability dashboard & alerts, fallback policy (model variant routing), billing/discount rules, and legal SLA text. Nina — can you lead scoping?

nina_pm: I can. Action items: 1) @sam_sales attach customer traffic profile + example payloads. 2) @aisha_cs attach residency/audit details. 3) @leo_eng run feasibility + cost delta + perf harness. 4) Legal to draft SLA clause. ETA: initial scoping doc in 5 business days.

sam_sales: I'll send traffic profile and a VectorOps contact this afternoon. They also asked for a 30-day canary at 99.95% before signing to validate ops.

leo_eng: OK I'll start a perf run. Quick technical decisions to make: define what counts as downtime (regional vs global), whether SLO is p95 or p99, and acceptable error budget. I recommend a tiered approach (e.g., 99.95 -> 99.99 ramp) with credits instead of hard penalty at day 1.

aisha_cs: For 24/7 P1 support: we need explicit oncall rotations + escalation matrix. Ops estimate: ~0.12 FTE per $100k commit for 24/7 coverage (ballpark). I'll add that to cost note.

oncall-bot: Ticket created: INF-2026 "VectorOps SLA intake" assigned to #product. Link: https://tracker.redwood/INF-2026 :white_check_mark:

ryan_p: Decision (tentative): route to product backlog as "enterprise-slo intake" candidate and slot into Q3 initiative "enterprise stability" with canary path. Prioritization: sales-driven but high-effort — will require exec signoff for committed discounts. Nina, please create epic + acceptance criteria in Jira within 48h.

nina_pm: Confirmed. I'll create the epic, add the acceptance criteria, and ping legal and eng owners. Will post the Jira link when ready. Thanks everyone :balloon:

Code block (sample acceptance criteria):
```
- SLO definition doc (scope, regional vs global, calculation window)
- Perf harness: p95 <= 50ms at specified QPS and payloads
- Fallback/rollback plan tested (canary + automatic fallback)
- SLA dashboard + alerts + runbooks in Console
- Legal SLA clause drafted and reviewed
```

sam_sales: Great — I'll follow up with the customer and attach the traffic dump to INF-2026 when I have it.
